question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Affirm
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Affirm**' means to say formally or clearly that something is true or that you support something strongly.(दावे से कहना)

 
 
• **Example **- He **affirmed **that he had never seen the stolen goods.
 
 
 
• '**Confirm**' means to say or show that something is true or correct, especially by giving evidence.(पुष्टि करना)
 
 
• **Example **- We will write to you to **confirm **that you have been offered the job.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of** 'Affirm' **is **'Confirm'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options along with their Hindi meanings and sentence examples.

 
• **Convey **(पहुंचाना, ले जाना) - To communicate or transmit something, especially information or ideas.

 
 
• **Example **- He tried to **convey **his feelings through his music.
 
 
 
• **Correlate **(सहसंबंधी) - To have or to show a relationship or connection between two or more things.
 
 
• **Example **- Studies have shown that smoking **correlates **with an increased risk of lung cancer.
 
 
 
• **Deliver **(पहुंचाना) - To take something (goods, letters, etc.) to the place requested or to the address on it.
 
 
• **Example **- The company will **deliver **the goods free of charge.
